claim_definition: Verifies that the policy version at T0 (governance_root.policy_version) is compared to the policy version at T1 (gate_decision.context_t1.policy_hash). If the policy changed, the gate MUST ESCALATE.
scope: dgv-verifier CLI execution - policy version consistency test

input.script:
harmony(1e-12)
bind_context("data_hash_v1", "policy_hash_v1")
evolve(2)
data(1000)
check_context_drift()
residual()

test_cases.description: The gate must compare policy version at T0 to T1. A changed policy MUST trigger ESCALATE.
